plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Transfer Pathway map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The live browser also transcribed this program's 2025-2026 map and compared it row by row: every Bakersfield College course row is identical in the two catalog years; only term numbering/years and milestone placement differ. This plan files the 2026-2027 view. This plan transcribes the Bakersfield College portion (Terms 1-4) of the first/default 'Transfer Pathway' (the Applied Exercise Science pathway). The same map continues at CSU Bakersfield with Kinesiology - Applied Exercise Science, Bachelor of Science, 60 units, Terms 9-12; that is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The program page lists two further pathways for the same AA-T credential (a Physical Activity Leadership pattern and a 'to CSU' pattern), which are not collected as separate plans. The transcribed map prints the Bakersfield College degree total as a range, 60-63 units, and term totals as 15-17 / 15-16 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Statistics' (4-4.5) and 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. The 'Statistics' slot and the Term 4 'Major List A' slot are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'Kinesiology Movement Based Courses' slot is printed once in each of Terms 1-3 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each term exactly as printed. BIOL B33 shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flag is disclosed on that course row. No other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in the Bakersfield College section. General-education, statistics, movement-based, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map (including the 'Biology Series' milestone in Term 2) carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
